answer: Put every earning identity through simultaneous live interrogation: a challenger asks follow-ups that branch from that identity's own earlier claims, probing deeper like water finding new channels in karst. One operator behind fifty clones must now sustain fifty distinct, coherent conversations at once, in real time, with no script that survives the second question. Answers that stay consistent past the horizon of prepared text earn; clones that echo, stall, or contradict their cedar-specific detail are merged and paid once.
